methodology_corrections: clean_volume=volume-daytrade_volume; clean_turnover=turnover-daytrade_turnover only when same units/date/source. No inferred turnover from adjusted price.
Only remove TSMC from an index where it is a constituent, using lagged weights and rebased return construction; never subtract stock price from index points.
Regression residuals reduce modeled market exposure; they do not guarantee complete noise removal.
Swing anchors require confirmation and available_at; no hindsight ZigZag pivots.
Fund shares x NAV is net creation/redemption estimate; cannot infer separate gross inflows and outflows from net shares alone.
Maintain calendar time for inactive/flat periods; filters do not delete time.
CSV UTF-8 BOM remains available alongside Parquet; no blanket replacement of all formats.
MOM/ROC are not guaranteed leading signals; ROC is unbounded above.
